ops.parking: Underground parking for 80 cars. Basic fee 300 yen for the first hour, then 150 yen per 30 minutes. Entry 7:00 to 26:00, exit 24 hours. Vehicle height up to 2.4 m (for large vehicles of 2.4 m or more, please inquire). Banquet guests can get a parking service ticket for free parking within 4 or 8 hours.
ops.waitingRooms: The small banquet halls (7 rooms of 53 to 83㎡) are described as usable for small meals, meetings and waiting rooms. The special room Tengen has a 28㎡ Western-style room and a 28㎡ Japanese-style room, listed on the price list.
ops.catering: Bringing food or drink into the banquet halls is prohibited. The hotel's plated dishes are available from 20 people and standing or seated buffets from 25 people; the party plan is from 20 people (2-hour all-you-can-drink, room fee included, from 8,500 yen; service charge and tax included). (Banquet Hall Terms of Use, February 2024 edition)
ops.restaurants: The hotel has Buffet & Dining LUMIÈRE, Musashino Japanese Restaurant and Chinese Cuisine Hakurakuten. All three have private rooms, and each offers group plans.
